Ha, the 0-3 thing was kinda intentional tbh: 1 first try plus 3 retries. Though the PR description says "3 tries" so I can reword that. Making it generic feels like scope creep for today, we can pull it out in a follow-up 🙏 And the setTimeout is only 100-400ms, so there's nothing worth cancelling, the request just finishes.

On double charges: no, retries are safe. Paystream already dedupes charges on orderId (it's in the metadata we send), so the same order can't be charged twice even if we hit it again after a timeout.
